source_definition.statement: Delta is k-independent with respect to Gamma iff every CSP(Gamma union Delta) instance is satisfiable whenever every subinstance with at most k Delta constraints is satisfiable.

frozen_language.cover_structure: For each fixed first sign bit, the four covers are all four 3-subsets of the four relations in that layer.

proof_core: Horn-like Gamma OR Delta* requires at most one Gamma relation per frozen three-sheet cover.
All 3-subsets occur inside each four-relation first-sign layer, hence Gamma contains at most one relation per layer and at most two total.
Therefore Delta has at least six of the eight relations.
The eight relations form four complementary pairs M_tau, M_not_tau.
Any six-element Delta contains at least two complementary pairs.
1-independence implies GS(Delta) by taking the Gamma core empty.
Each complementary pair is jointly unsatisfiable on one variable triple, so GS(Delta) fails.
